success.evidence: Four canonical projects and detail routes load, category filters update results, all 23 categories expose their complete ordered skills, and diagram activation settles with a persistent explanatory status.

permission.reason: Static portfolio has no authentication, permission request, remote submission or privileged action. SOAR approval is explicitly an illustrative simulated control.
